extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners, petitioners, patent owners, USPTO staff, and stakeholders tracking PTAB/AIA outcomes
extracted.subtask_description: A fiscal-year summary of Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) metrics for AIA proceedings (IPR and PGR), including counts, institution rates, settlement rates, and outcomes by petition/patent/claim. The page defines how several rates are calculated and what outcome categories mean.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions filed by trial type
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and percent breakdown of petitions by trial type for the fiscal year (FY24: Oct. 1, 2023 to Sept. 30, 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trial types include Inter Partes Review (IPR) and Post Grant Review (PGR). Reported values: IPR 1,250 (97%), PGR 38 (3%), Total 1,288.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions filed by technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and percentage distribution of petitions by technology category for the fiscal year (e.g., Electrical/Computer, Mechanical & Business Method, Chemical, Bio/Pharma, Design).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported FY24 breakdown: Electrical/Computer 887 (69%), Mechanical & Business Method 285 (22%), Chemical 40 (3%), Bio/Pharma 73 (6%), Design 3 (<1%).

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions filed by month
rubrics_metrics.description: Monthly counts of petitions (separately reported for IPR and PGR) over the 12-month period ending Sept. 30, 2024 (and specifically September 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shows monthly time series for IPRs (e.g., months with counts such as 121, 118, 91, etc.) and for PGRs (smaller counts such as 4, 5, 1, etc.). Used to track filing trends over the year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution rates by petition (FY20–FY24)
rubrics_metrics.description: Year-by-year percentage and counts of petitions that were instituted versus denied, reported 'by petition' for FY20 through FY24.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Charts show instituted and denied counts and percent institution for each fiscal year (e.g., FY20–FY24). (Decisions on rehearing outcomes are excluded where noted elsewhere.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution rates by patent (FY20–FY24)
rubrics_metrics.description: Year-by-year percentage and counts of patents for which at least one proceeding was instituted versus denied, reported 'by patent' for FY20 through FY24.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Displays instituted vs denied patent counts and institution percentages each fiscal year. The 'by patent' view differs from 'by petition' by collapsing multiple petitions to the patent level.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution rates by technology (FY24)
rubrics_metrics.description: Institution rate calculated for each technology by dividing petitions instituted by decisions on institution (i.e., petitions instituted plus petitions denied).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit calculation: outcomes of decisions on institution responsive to requests for rehearing are excluded. Example reported FY24 rates include: Electrical/Computer 69% (507 of 732), Mechanical & Business Method 66% (160 of 243), Chemical 46% (12 of 26), Bio/Pharma 73% (61 of 84), Design 0% (0 of 2).

rubrics_metrics.name: Settlement rate and settlement timing (FY20–FY24)
rubrics_metrics.description: Settlement rate for AIA proceedings each fiscal year and the distribution of settlements occurring pre-institution vs post-institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Settlement rate is calculated by dividing total settlements by concluded proceedings in each fiscal year (i.e., denied institution, settled, dismissed, requested adverse judgment, and final written decision), excluding joined cases. Reported FY20–FY24 shows overall settlement rates and counts, plus percent pre-institution vs post-institution (e.g., FY24 settlement rate 32% with breakdowns for pre/post institution).

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes by petition (FWD-based)
rubrics_metrics.description: Outcomes reported by petition indicating whether a final written decision (FWD) reported patentability or unpatentability with respect to the claims at issue in the FWD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Joined cases are excluded from the petition-level FWD outcome counts. Outcomes are reported based on the content of FWDs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes by patent (FWD and mixed outcomes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Outcomes reported by patent indicating whether patents received FWDs reporting patentability or unpatentability; includes a 'Mixed Outcome' category for patents receiving more than one outcome type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 'Mixed Outcome' is shown for patents receiving more than one type of outcome from the list: denied, settled, dismissed, and/or request for adverse judgement only. A patent is listed in an FWD category if it ever received a FWD, regardless of other outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes by claim challenged
rubrics_metrics.description: Outcomes reported at the claim level for challenged claims during the fiscal year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims are categorized by the disposition reached in DIs/FWDs; joined cases are excluded where noted in petition-level reporting. (Page shows claim-level outcome counts/percentages for FY24.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Claim outcomes: 'No DI' and 'No FWD' definitions and unpatentability rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions for special claim-level outcome labels and reported rates of unpatentability among challenged and instituted claims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 'No DI' and 'No FWD' mean the claim was challenged but not addressed in a Decision on Institution (DI) or Final Written Decision (FWD), e.g., due to settlement. Reported statistic: 30% of challenged claims and 49% of instituted claims were found unpatentable by a preponderance of the evidence (FY24).

rubrics_metrics.name: Events that end an AIA proceeding (patent-level reporting)
rubrics_metrics.description: List of event types treated as ending an AIA proceeding for the purpose of patent-level counts and categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Events that end an AIA proceeding include final written decisions (FWD), settlements, dismissals, requests for adverse judgment, and denials of institution. For patent-level FWD categorization, a patent is listed in an FWD category if it ever received a FWD.

rubrics_metrics.name: All patents: cumulative (all-time) and FY summaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Aggregated patent-level metrics reported for the fiscal year and for the all-time period (Sept. 16, 2012 to Sept. 30, 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides cumulative totals and distributions across outcome categories for the all-time period and separately for FY24; used to view long-term trends in PTAB activity.
